_meta.source: Computed styles read live in the signed-in app (built-in browser pane, 1440x900, dark theme), 2026-10-17. States reached with the real keyboard or pointer.

menu-item-focus-visible.how: header Menu button focused, Enter, ArrowDown

button3d-blue-hover.how: real pointer over the home 'Start' button (Chrome)
button3d-blue-hover.--button3d-hover-tint: (unset in Chrome; Safari paints var(--button3d-hover-tint) on ::after instead of the opacity)

text-area-koji-focused-filled.how: clicked the /koji/ prompt and typed a question (not sent)
text-area-koji-focused-filled.element: textarea (placeholder 'Something else…') in the glass prompt pill
text-area-koji-focused-filled.focus ring: none on the textarea or pill (outline style none); focus is shown by the caret only

text-field-invalid-email.how: Settings > Account > Add another email, typed 'not-an-email', pressed Add email once (approved by the owner); the browser blocked the submit, so no request was sent
text-field-invalid-email.validationMessage: Please include an '@' in the email address. 'not-an-email' is missing an '@'. (Chrome's native bubble)
text-field-invalid-email.finding: The product paints no error style on this field; the browser's native validation bubble is the only error shown.

segment-keyboard-focus.how: Preferences colour-mode segment focused after a Tab keypress (real keyboard modality)
segment-keyboard-focus.finding: No focus indicator: the segment looks the same focused and unfocused.

toast-favourite.how: Topics: unstarred Math Foundations, then starred it again (owner approved); each click fired a Sonner toast
toast-favourite.account: unchanged at the end (Math Foundations starred, back at the top)
